# Debt Free — محرر الديون

> A private, offline-first web app (PWA) that tells you the exact month you will be debt-free and compares the Snowball and Avalanche payoff strategies. Arabic-first (RTL) with English, built for Kuwait and the GCC by X Star Software.

- No accounts, no servers, no tracking: all data stays in the browser (IndexedDB) and can be exported as a JSON backup.
- Strategies: Snowball (smallest balance first) and Avalanche (highest rate first), with freed payments rolling over to the next debt.
- Features: extra monthly payment, one-time or yearly bonus payments, a custom payoff order, per-debt payoff dates, a monthly check-in that logs every planned payment at once (with streak and goal tracking), payment history with undo, monthly schedule, debt-to-income ratio, Islamic-finance terminology (profit instead of interest), printable plan, calendar reminder, passphrase-encrypted backups and a shareable progress card that contains no amounts.
- Contract helper: converts a flat-rate loan (rate on the original amount) to its real reducing-balance rate; 4% flat over 5 years is about 7.42% a year.
- Debt buyout calculator: compares a bank's consolidation offer with the current loans on installment, term and total cost.
- Figures are planning estimates; lenders may calculate differently (daily interest, fees, early-settlement terms).

App: https://debt-free-tracker-phi.vercel.app/

Guides (Arabic):
- Snowball or avalanche: https://debt-free-tracker-phi.vercel.app/guides/snowball-vs-avalanche.html
- Flat vs reducing rates: https://debt-free-tracker-phi.vercel.app/guides/flat-vs-reducing-rate.html
- Debt buyouts: https://debt-free-tracker-phi.vercel.app/guides/debt-buyout.html
